info.title: app_1 API
info.description:
Restyles a photo of a room without changing the room.

The mechanism is two calls: a vision pass inventories what is in the photo, and a generate pass names those items verbatim so the model knows what to preserve. There is no mask — masking was tested and does not preserve anything. See PRD.md.

post.summary: Exchange an Apple identity token for our tokens
post.description:
Verifies the token against Apple's keys. Creates the user and grants one free
room on first sight. Rate limit 10/hr per IP.

post.summary: Trade a refresh token for a new access token

get.description:
The user's own rooms, most recent first. Powers the app's home/history
screen — no other operation lists rooms across a user, only within one.

schema.title: Response List Rooms V1 Rooms Get

post.description:
One photo per room; we do not ask for more. Max 12 MB.

HEIC is what iPhones produce by default and the image API does not accept it,
so the client converts to JPEG before upload. The server rejects anything that
is not JPEG or PNG with `photo_unsupported`.

delete.summary: Delete a room and its photos

post.summary: Find what is in the room
post.description:
A vision call lists the room's fixed architecture and its moveable objects,
labelled A, B, C. Architecture is always listed and never removable — it is what
the generate step must preserve. Takes a few seconds; called once per room.

Queues a render. The prompt is built from the inventory: architecture under
"must remain exactly where they are", kept objects under "keep in the same
positions", and `remove_ids` under "remove entirely".

Spends one credit. Returns immediately with status `queued`; the client polls
`GET /v1/renders/{id}` every 2 seconds. A failed render refunds its credit.

schema.title: Response List Renders V1 Rooms  Room Id  Renders Get

get.description:
`down` blocks deploys, `degraded` pages someone, `ok` does nothing. Checks the
database, photo storage, the queue table, worker heartbeat and queue depth.

Leads with preservation rate (mean and 5th percentile) and inventory failure
rate — together they say whether the promise is holding.

identity_token.title: Identity Token
identity_token.description: The identity token from Sign in with Apple.

message.title: Message
message.description: Shown to the user verbatim. Keep it plain.

state.description: down blocks deploys. degraded pages someone. ok does nothing.

room_type.description: The vision call's best guess. Null if it could not say — the client then asks rather than pre-selecting.

id.title: Id
id.description: A, B, C … shown to the user.

name.title: Name
name.description: Short label for the confirm screen.

description.title: Description
description.description: Positional description for the image model.

removable.title: Removable
removable.description: Architecture is never removable. Objects are.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description:
One thing found in the room.

`name` is shown to the user next to its letter. `description` is never shown —
it goes verbatim into the image prompt, which is why it must be positional and
specific ("deep rectangular wall alcove centred above and to the right of the
fireplace"), not a bare noun.

credits_left.title: Credits Left
credits_left.description: Rooms remaining. One free room at signup.

url.title: Url
url.description: Short-lived read URL for the client.

preservation_rate.title: Preservation Rate
preservation_rate.description: Share of architectural inventory items still present in the result, judged by a vision call. Not a pixel comparison — output is never aligned with input.

missing_items.title: Missing Items
missing_items.description: Inventory ids the check could not find in the result.

room_type.description: What was actually used for this render (request value, else detected, else null) — echoed so history is self-describing.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional free text. Cannot override preservation.

remove_ids.title: Remove Ids
remove_ids.description: Inventory ids the user tapped to remove. Everything else is kept.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Client-generated. A retry with the same key returns the existing render rather than spending a second credit.

room_type.description: The user's confirmed room type. Null means: use whatever the inventory detected, falling back to the room's label, falling back to the word 'room'.

walls.description: Whether the wall colour may change. Defaults to leaving it — the one field whose default is not today's behaviour (options_review/HANDOFF.md §1.1).

furniture.description: Whether new furniture may be introduced.

add_furniture.title: Add Furniture
add_furniture.description: Furniture-type ids to add, from the list for the room's `room_type` (options_review/HANDOFF.md §7.2). Only read when furniture=='add'. The backend validates ids against that room type's list (422 if unknown).

palette.description: Colour family override. 'as_style' leaves the chosen style's own palette line as-is.

thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url
thumbnail_url.description: Signed read URL for the room's latest done render's after-image, or its original photo if no render has finished yet. Null if the room has no photo. Same short-lived /files/... scheme as Photo.url and Render.after_url — never cached by key, reissued on every read.

RoomType.title: RoomType
RoomType.description:
The 12 room types from the options-round handoff (options_review/HANDOFF.md
§7.1). Detected by the inventory vision call; the user may confirm or change it
on the render request. The wire value is also what the prompt names as `where`.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.
